question: What is the role of the <title> element for SEO?
shortAnswer: Primary snippet title signal and browser tab label; unique per page.
detailedAnswer: Keep concise and descriptive. Don't keyword-stuff. Align with h1 thematically without duplication spam.

question: Explain meta description best practices.
shortAnswer: Summarizes the page for SERP snippets; not a direct ranking factor but affects CTR.
detailedAnswer: Unique, compelling, within typical display length. Avoid duplicate sitewide descriptions.

question: How do canonical URLs help?
shortAnswer: They declare the preferred URL when duplicates/near-duplicates exist.
detailedAnswer: Use absolute URLs. Self-referential canonicals are common. Wrong canonicals can deindex pages.

question: What Open Graph tags matter for sharing?
shortAnswer: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url (and twitter cards similarly).
detailedAnswer: They control link previews on social platforms. Images should meet size guidelines.

question: How does heading structure affect SEO?
shortAnswer: Clear hierarchy helps crawlers and users understand topical structure.
detailedAnswer: One clear h1, logical nesting, don't use headings only for styling. Content quality still dominates.

question: What is robots meta vs robots.txt?
shortAnswer: robots.txt governs crawling paths; meta robots governs indexing/snippet behavior per page.
detailedAnswer: noindex can still allow crawl depending on setup. Disallow doesn't remove already indexed URLs alone.

question: When should you use JSON-LD structured data?
shortAnswer: To describe entities (Article, Product, FAQ) for rich results — matching visible content.
detailedAnswer: Keep accurate and maintained. Misleading schema risks manual actions.

question: How do SPAs hurt SEO if misconfigured?
shortAnswer: Critical content may be client-only, slow TTFB/LCP, or missing unique titles per route.
detailedAnswer: Prefer SSR/SSG or prerender for indexable routes. Ensure crawlable links (a href).

question: What is hreflang used for?
shortAnswer: Signals language/region variants of a page to search engines.
detailedAnswer: Must be reciprocal and consistent. Mistakes can cause wrong locale in SERPs.

question: How do you SEO-audit a marketing landing page?
shortAnswer: Titles/meta, headings, crawlability, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internal links, indexability.
detailedAnswer: Check rendered HTML, not just source templates. Validate with Search Console.

question: Why do crawlable links matter more than onclick navigation?
shortAnswer: Crawlers discover pages via href; JS-only navigation may hide routes.
detailedAnswer: Use real anchors progressive-enhanced with client routers.

question: Define an SEO content architecture for a large docs site.
shortAnswer: Stable URL taxonomy, canonical rules, sitemap strategy, pagination, unique titles at scale.
detailedAnswer: Automate metadata. Prevent soft-404s. Align IA with search intent clusters.
